SharedFlowBundle.name: SF-Signature-Router
SharedFlowBundle.Description: Single entry point for message signing. Calling API proxies set the signature.type flow variable (jwt | xmldsig | cavage) and invoke this shared flow via FlowCallout; it routes to the matching sub-step. For JWT, the finished JWS is written into a request header whose NAME is also per-proxy config, from the shared KVM "signature" (entry key "{apiproxy.name}.jwt.output") — see JS-JWT-Set-Output-Header. For XML-DSig, the finished document (with the signer's X.509 certificate embedded in KeyInfo, so it can be validated by any XML-DSig verifier, not just this gateway's own) lands in signature.xmldsig.signed.document — see JC-Assemble-XmlDsig-Signature.
